name: Proxmox VE Detection Suite
summary: Tasks, high availability, cluster quorum, Ceph health, REST API changes and /etc/pve file integrity on Proxmox VE, where Wazuh only decodes logins.
summary_zh: Proxmox VE 的任務、高可用、叢集 quorum、Ceph 健康狀態、REST API 變更與 /etc/pve 檔案完整性；Wazuh 內建只解碼登入。
notes: Wazuh ships decoders for pvedaemon, pveproxy and pvestatd and four rules, all about logins. Everything else a cluster writes (tasks, HA, corosync, backup results, configuration changes, the Ceph cluster log) arrived undecoded and matched nothing, or matched the generic rule 1002. Log strings and task names were checked against the Proxmox VE 9.2 sources (pve-manager 9.2.21, qemu-server 9.2.10, libpve-access-control 9.1.2) and Ceph 19.2.

Tasks: a guest destroyed is level 8, a snapshot rollback level 6, a root shell on the node opened from the web interface level 5, a guest console, creation, migration, file transfer or volume deletion level 3. Destroying storage (disk wipe, ZFS, LVM or directory storage removed) is level 8, a Ceph pool or file system destroyed level 10, a Ceph daemon destroyed level 6, backups pruned by hand level 5, a cluster created or joined level 8. A failed task is level 5; a backup job that ends with errors, or a guest whose backup failed, is level 10.

Configuration changes from the cluster log: a hookscript set on a VM is level 10 (it runs as root on the host at every start and stop), raw QEMU arguments level 8, the root@pam password changed level 8, another password level 5, a node added to the cluster level 10, removed level 6. Proxmox VE does not log container configuration changes at all.

High availability and quorum: a node being fenced and this node losing quorum are level 12; an HA service in error or recovery is level 10; a node that drops out of the cluster is level 4, and level 8 when it happens six times in an hour. Corosync link flaps are recorded below the alert level and raise level 7 only in a burst, because a busy cluster network produces hundreds a month. The cluster file system losing corosync (corosync stopped, restarted or crashed) is level 5, and the firewall service stopping and removing its rules level 6.

Ceph health from the cluster log on monitor nodes: a health check that starts is level 7 (warning) or 10 (error), level 10 for a down OSD or monitor and 12 for a full OSD or pool or damaged placement groups; a check whose summary changes is level 3 (7 for an error), a cleared check level 3. While a warning lasts Ceph repeats a summary every ten minutes; those repeats are recorded below the alert level (a 40-minute clock skew was 23 alerts at level 7 in 1.1, now 2). The agent group drops the [DBG] lines (about 99 per cent of the log) and the regular HEALTH_OK. Every monitor node writes the whole cluster log, so an event arrives once per monitor node.

REST API from the pveproxy access log: failed logins (level 5; six from one address in two minutes, level 10), and changes that succeeded: users, permissions and realms (level 8), API tokens and a second factor removed (level 10), guest deletion, a backup or a backup job deleted, the datacenter firewall options and a guest OS password set through the guest agent (level 8), firewall changes and commands sent into a guest through its agent (level 6), uploads to storage (level 5), cluster configuration (level 6). The agent group sends these lines under the program name jt-pveproxy so that the pack's decoder reads them: pveproxy logs an IPv4 client as ::ffff:a.b.c.d, the built-in decoders keep that prefix, and Wazuh's firewall-drop then writes an ip6tables rule that the client's IPv4 traffic never meets. The pack's decoder reports the plain IPv4 address.

Successful logins: the built-in rule 87203 alerts at level 3 on every login, and a monitoring system that logs in every few seconds makes that tens of thousands of alerts a day (measured: 20,880 a day from one monitoring account, against 7 root logins). The pack records an ordinary account's login at level 2, keeps root@pam's visible at level 3, and raises a login that follows six failures for the same account to level 12. A correct password with a wrong second factor is level 8, a second-factor lockout level 10. pvedaemon's success line carries no client address; the access log does: a login from a public address is level 5 the first time that address is seen and level 3 after that, and level 12 right after repeated failures from it. The first change an account makes from an address is level 3 (root@pam: 5), once. This works on a fresh install; etc/lists/jt-pve-service-accounts is optional tuning that drops listed accounts' logins to level 0.

File integrity of /etc/pve (every Linux agent watches /etc by default): /etc/pve is pmxcfs, a database exposed as files, which renumbers inodes, touches modification times, keeps status and HA state files that change every few seconds and writes through temporary files; vzdump adds and removes a lock line in every guest's configuration at each backup. Measured on one cluster: about 2,500 FIM alerts a day at level 5 and 7, all routine; with the pack about one. What remains: API token secrets, the cluster-wide root SSH keys and the cluster CA (level 10), corosync.conf, users and realms (level 8), second factors and pve realm passwords, the datacenter and node firewall, backup jobs (level 6), a snippet added (level 6, the agent group watches /var/lib/vz/snippets). A cluster-wide file is reported by every node.

Not covered: what changed inside a guest configuration (FIM sees that it changed, not how; report_changes would show it, but the diffs carry guest descriptions, which some sites use for passwords), container configuration (not logged by Proxmox VE), and the installed version (no component logs it in a line the agent reads). Proxmox Backup Server has a pack of its own, jt-pbs.

Cross-pack login groups (patch release): jt_auth_success on 131203, 131204, 131205, 131287; jt_auth_failure on 131266; jt_auth_lockout on 131208. They let jt-account-guard correlate logins across services and jt-ioc look up the address of every tagged successful login; levels and matching are unchanged, and without those packs the groups do nothing. Proxmox VE logs a login twice and neither copy has both fields: pvedaemon names the account but not the address, the pveproxy access line has the address but no account. Successes are tagged on pvedaemon (131203, 131204, 131205, 131287), failures on pveproxy (131266, plain address); the pvedaemon failure is the built-in rule 87201, which a pack cannot tag. 131208 (second factor locked) is jt_auth_lockout; its address keeps the ::ffff: prefix of the built-in decoder. 131267 now counts failures through the pack-only group jt_pve_web_failure (on 131266 only) instead of if_matched_sid 131266: same rule, same threshold, but the failures also reach the cross-pack group lists, which skip any rule named by an if_matched_sid.
notes_zh: Wazuh 內建 pvedaemon、pveproxy、pvestatd 的解碼器與四條規則，全都只管登入。叢集寫出的其他內容（任務、HA、corosync、備份結果、設定變更、Ceph 叢集記錄）送進來後沒有解碼、也不命中任何規則，或只命中通用的 1002。記錄字串與任務名稱已對照 Proxmox VE 9.2 原始碼（pve-manager 9.2.21、qemu-server 9.2.10、libpve-access-control 9.1.2）與 Ceph 19.2。

任務：刪除 guest 為 level 8，回復快照 level 6，從網頁介面開啟節點本身的 root shell 為 level 5，開啟 guest 主控台、建立、遷移、傳送檔案或刪除磁碟區為 level 3。摧毀儲存（抹除磁碟、移除 ZFS、LVM 或目錄儲存）為 level 8，摧毀 Ceph pool 或檔案系統為 level 10，摧毀 Ceph daemon 為 level 6，手動修剪備份為 level 5，建立或加入叢集為 level 8。任務失敗為 level 5；備份工作以錯誤結束，或某台 guest 備份失敗，為 level 10。
叢集記錄裡的設定變更：VM 設定 hookscript 為 level 10（每次開機與關機都以 root 在主機上執行），設定原始 QEMU 參數為 level 8，root@pam 密碼變更為 level 8，其他帳號的密碼為 level 5，叢集新增節點為 level 10、移除節點為 level 6。Proxmox VE 完全不記錄容器的設定變更。

高可用與 quorum：節點被 fence、本節點失去 quorum 為 level 12；HA 服務進入 error 或 recovery 為 level 10；節點脫離叢集為 level 4，一小時內發生六次則為 level 8。corosync 連線閃斷記錄在告警等級之下，只有短時間大量發生才升為 level 7，因為繁忙的叢集網路一個月就有數百次。叢集檔案系統與 corosync 斷線（corosync 停止、重啟或當掉）為 level 5，防火牆服務停止並移除規則為 level 6。

Ceph 健康狀態取自 monitor 節點的叢集記錄：健康檢查開始時為 level 7（警告）或 10（錯誤），OSD、monitor 停擺為 level 10，OSD 或 pool 滿了、placement group 損壞為 level 12；檢查的摘要改變為 level 3（錯誤為 7），檢查解除為 level 3。警告持續期間 Ceph 每十分鐘重複一次摘要，這些重複記錄在告警等級之下（1.1 時一次 40 分鐘的時鐘偏差產生 23 筆 level 7，現在 2 筆）。agent 群組會丟掉 [DBG] 行（約占記錄 99%）與例行的 HEALTH_OK。每個 monitor 節點都寫完整的叢集記錄，所以同一事件會從每個 monitor 節點各來一次。

pveproxy 存取記錄裡的 REST API：登入失敗（level 5；同一位址兩分鐘內六次為 level 10），以及成功的變更：使用者、權限與 realm（level 8）、API token 與移除第二因素（level 10）、刪除 guest、刪除備份或備份工作、資料中心防火牆選項、透過 guest agent 設定 guest 作業系統密碼（level 8）、防火牆變更與透過 guest agent 對 guest 下指令（level 6）、上傳到儲存區（level 5）、叢集設定（level 6）。agent 群組以程式名稱 jt-pveproxy 送出這些記錄，讓套件自己的解碼器讀取：pveproxy 把 IPv4 用戶端記成 ::ffff:a.b.c.d，內建解碼器保留這個前綴，Wazuh 的 firewall-drop 就會寫成 ip6tables 規則，用戶端的 IPv4 流量永遠碰不到。套件的解碼器回報的是單純的 IPv4 位址。

成功登入：內建規則 87203 對每一次登入都告警 level 3，每幾秒登入一次的監控系統會讓它一天變成幾萬筆（實測：一個監控帳號一天 20,880 筆，root 只有 7 筆）。套件把一般帳號的登入記成 level 2，root@pam 的登入維持 level 3 可見，同一帳號失敗六次後的登入升到 level 12。密碼正確但第二因素錯誤為 level 8，第二因素被鎖定為 level 10。pvedaemon 的成功記錄沒有用戶端位址，存取記錄有：從公開位址登入，該位址第一次出現時為 level 5、之後為 level 3，緊接在同一位址多次失敗之後則為 level 12。某帳號第一次從某位址做變更為 level 3（root@pam 為 5），只有一次。裝上去就有效；etc/lists/jt-pve-service-accounts 只是選用的微調，列入的帳號登入降為 level 0。

/etc/pve 的檔案完整性（每個 Linux agent 預設都監看 /etc）：/etc/pve 是 pmxcfs，以檔案形式呈現的資料庫，會重新編號 inode、更新修改時間、狀態檔與 HA 狀態檔每幾秒就變，寫入時經過暫存檔；vzdump 每次備份都會在每台 guest 的設定加上再移除一行鎖定。一個叢集實測：每天約 2,500 筆 level 5 與 7 的 FIM 告警，全是例行；裝了套件後約 1 筆。留下的是：API token 密鑰、全叢集的 root SSH 金鑰與叢集 CA（level 10），corosync.conf、使用者與 realm（level 8），第二因素與 pve realm 密碼、資料中心與節點防火牆、備份工作（level 6），新增 snippet（level 6，agent 群組會監看 /var/lib/vz/snippets）。全叢集共用的檔案會由每個節點各回報一次。
未涵蓋：guest 設定裡改了什麼（FIM 只看得到有變、看不到怎麼變；report_changes 看得到，但差異內容會帶出 guest 的描述欄，有些站台把密碼寫在那裡）、容器設定（Proxmox VE 不記錄）、安裝的版本（沒有元件在 agent 讀得到的記錄行裡寫出版本）。Proxmox Backup Server 另有自己的套件 jt-pbs。

跨套件登入群組（修補版）：jt_auth_success：131203, 131204, 131205, 131287；jt_auth_failure：131266；jt_auth_lockout：131208。讓 jt-account-guard 跨服務關聯登入、jt-ioc 查詢每一筆加標記的成功登入來源位址；等級與比對條件不變，沒有安裝這些套件時群組沒有作用。Proxmox VE 一次登入記兩份，而且兩份都不完整：pvedaemon 有帳號沒位址，pveproxy 存取記錄有位址沒帳號。成功登入標在 pvedaemon（131203、131204、131205、131287），失敗標在 pveproxy（131266，純位址）；pvedaemon 的失敗是內建規則 87201，套件不能替它加標記。131208（第二因素鎖定）標為 jt_auth_lockout，它的位址仍帶內建解碼器的 ::ffff: 前綴。131267 改以只在 131266 上的套件專屬群組 jt_pve_web_failure 計算失敗，不再用 if_matched_sid 131266：同樣的規則與門檻，但失敗事件也能進入跨套件群組清單（被 if_matched_sid 指名的規則會被群組清單略過）。
author: Jason Tools

agent_group.name: proxmox
agent_group.description: The Proxmox logs outside syslog: REST API changes and public logins from the pveproxy access log, the Ceph cluster log on monitor nodes, and file integrity of the snippets directory

setup.title: Install the pack and reload the ruleset
setup.title_zh: 安裝套件並重新載入規則集
setup.body:
1. Install the pack from this page.
2. On the Rules tab, press Reload Ruleset. It reloads every cluster node; the cluster copies rule files to the workers but does not reload them.
setup.body_zh:
1. 在本頁安裝套件。
2. 到「規則」分頁按「重新載入規則集」，所有叢集節點都會重新載入；叢集會把規則檔複製到 worker，但不會替它們重新載入。
setup.verify: /var/ossec/bin/wazuh-analysisd -t on the manager prints no error or warning.
setup.verify_zh: 在 manager 上執行 /var/ossec/bin/wazuh-analysisd -t，沒有任何錯誤或警告。

setup.title: Add the Proxmox nodes to the proxmox group
setup.title_zh: 把 Proxmox 節點加入 proxmox 群組
setup.body:
1. Add each Proxmox VE node to the proxmox group and restart its agent (commands below; <agent_id> is the node's agent ID).
2. Keep the out_format line in the group configuration: without it the REST API rules and the active response receive nothing.
3. On a node that logs only to journald (no /var/log/syslog), add a journald localfile to that agent's own ossec.conf, or the task, HA and corosync rules see nothing.
setup.body_zh:
1. 把每台 Proxmox VE 節點加入 proxmox 群組並重啟它的 agent（指令如下；<agent_id> 是該節點的 agent ID）。
2. 保留群組設定裡的 out_format 那一行：少了它，REST API 規則與主動回應都收不到記錄。
3. 若節點只寫 journald（沒有 /var/log/syslog），請在該 agent 自己的 ossec.conf 加上 journald 的 localfile，否則任務、HA 與 corosync 規則都看不到。
setup.verify: Open a node shell from the web interface. Expect rule 131215 (level 5) on the manager.
setup.verify_zh: 從網頁介面開啟節點 shell，manager 端應出現規則 131215（level 5）。

setup.title: Optional: list monitoring accounts
setup.body:
Not needed: routine logins already stay below the alert level. A listed account's logins drop from level 2 to level 0; its failed logins still alert.
Add one line per account, the user name without its realm (<user> below), then reload the ruleset.
setup.body_zh:
不是必要的：例行登入本來就在告警等級以下。列入的帳號登入由 level 2 降為 level 0，登入失敗照樣告警。
每個帳號一行，寫不含 realm 的使用者名稱（下方的 <user>），然後重新載入規則集。

setup.title: Updating from 1.1: update the group configuration
setup.title_zh: 從 1.1 更新：更新群組設定
setup.body:
1. If the update reports the proxmox group file as modified by the site, merge the pack's agent.conf (below) into it by hand: 1.2 keeps successful logins from public addresses, watches /var/lib/vz/snippets and skips the HA state files under /etc/pve.
2. Restart the agents of the Proxmox nodes (command below).
setup.body_zh:
1. 若更新結果顯示 proxmox 群組檔案已被站台修改，請把套件的 agent.conf（下方）手動合併進去：1.2 會保留來自公開位址的成功登入、監看 /var/lib/vz/snippets，並略過 /etc/pve 底下的 HA 狀態檔。
2. 重啟 Proxmox 節點的 agent（指令如下）。
setup.verify: Create a file in /var/lib/vz/snippets on a node. Expect rule 131293 (level 6).
setup.verify_zh: 在節點的 /var/lib/vz/snippets 建立一個檔案，應出現規則 131293（level 6）。

setup.title: Expect fewer /etc/pve and Ceph alerts
setup.title_zh: /etc/pve 與 Ceph 的告警會變少
setup.body: Nothing to do. Since 1.2, /etc/pve changes without new content, the lock line each backup writes into guest configurations and Ceph's ten-minute repeats of an ongoing warning stay below the alert level. Dashboards filtered on rule 550 for /etc/pve, or on rule 131251, will show much less.
setup.body_zh: 不需要做任何事。1.2 起，沒有內容變更的 /etc/pve 事件、每次備份寫進 guest 設定的鎖定行，以及 Ceph 對持續中警告每十分鐘的重複，都留在告警等級之下。以規則 550 篩選 /etc/pve、或以規則 131251 篩選的儀表板會少很多。

active_response.title: Block an address that keeps failing to log in to the web interface
active_response.title_zh: 封鎖一再登入網頁介面失敗的位址
active_response.body: Drops traffic from the source address on the node that was attacked, for 10 minutes, after six failed logins from that address within two minutes (rule 131267, from the pveproxy access log). It uses iptables or nftables on the node, alongside the Proxmox firewall. It is not attached to the built-in brute-force rule 87202: that rule's address carries the ::ffff: prefix, which firewall-drop turns into an ip6tables rule that IPv4 traffic never meets. Needs the proxmox agent group. Risk: an administrator who mistypes a password repeatedly is locked out of that node for 10 minutes, and so is everyone behind the same NAT address, including a monitoring or backup system that logs in with a stale password. Put management networks in the manager's white_list first.
active_response.body_zh: 同一位址兩分鐘內登入失敗六次後（規則 131267，來自 pveproxy 存取記錄），在被攻擊的節點上封鎖該來源位址 10 分鐘。它在節點上使用 iptables 或 nftables，與 Proxmox 防火牆並存。沒有掛在內建的暴力破解規則 87202 上：那條規則的位址帶有 ::ffff: 前綴，firewall-drop 會寫成 IPv4 流量永遠碰不到的 ip6tables 規則。需要 proxmox agent 群組。風險：一再打錯密碼的管理者會被擋在該節點外 10 分鐘，同一個 NAT 位址後的所有使用者也一樣，包括用舊密碼登入的監控或備份系統。請先把管理網段加入 manager 的 white_list。
